[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if n < 2 then false
else
  let rec is_prime' (i: Nat): Bool :=
    if i * i > n then true
    else
      if n % i = 0 then false
      else is_prime' (i + 1)
  is_prime' 2
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma is_prime'_termination
(i: Nat)
(n: Nat)
(h_i_square_gt_n: i * i > n)
: is_prime' i n = true :=
by
rw [is_prime']
simp [h_i_square_gt_n]
